title: Fleur: Sherry LeBlanc's Deck (lore build)
summary: Fleur is Sherry LeBlanc's series in Yu-Gi-Oh! 5D's, and it only has a handful of cards. So this list is Sherry's own deck, using the real cards that came from it. Her Turbo Deck ran Fleur Synchron with the Sacred Knights and their horse, building to Chevalier de Fleur. Her Ground Deck ran Sorciere de Fleur and Necro Fleur.

summary.title: Starters & Enablers
points: Fleur Synchron, Chevalier de Fleur, Sorciere de Fleur and Necro Fleur, her original cards, with Sauge de Fleur and Fleuret de Fleur from 2021.

Her knights: the anime's "Sacred Knights" are the Noble Knights in Japanese. Noble Knight Joan, Noble Knight's Shield-Bearer and Noble Knight's Spearholder are the real versions, as is her steed, Horse of the Floral Knights.
Centaur Mina, the Fusion she makes from a knight and the horse, and Ecole de Zone, her Ground Deck Field Spell.
Necro Synchron, which counts as Fleur Synchron and summons the Level 1 Plant Necro Fleur.

summary.title: Opening: Horse of the Floral Knights
steps: Normal Summon Horse of the Floral Knights to add a Level 8 or lower LIGHT Noble Knight monster (Noble Knight's Spearholder or Noble Knight's Shield-Bearer) from your Deck to your hand.
Use Horse of the Floral Knights' on-field Ignition effect to Fusion Summon Centaur Mina using the horse and the searched LIGHT Warrior from your hand.
Activate Centaur Mina's Ignition effect to Special Summon a Level 2 or lower monster (such as Fleur Synchron or Necro Synchron) from your hand or GY.
Synchro Summon Chevalier de Fleur using Level 6 Centaur Mina and Level 2 Tuner Fleur Synchron.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoffs
points: Chevalier de Fleur negates the activation of an opponent's Spell or Trap Card once per turn during your turn, locking down disruptions while you attack.
Centaur Mina negates the activation of a Trap Card or Trap effect during your turn as a Quick Effect, and revives a Level 2 or lower monster from your hand or GY.

Sauge de Fleur Special Summons itself by targeting and destroying 1 monster you control and 1 card on the field, then shuffles itself into the Deck from the GY to retrieve a Level 1 Plant like Necro Fleur.
Sorciere de Fleur is summoned from your hand or Deck whenever Necro Fleur is destroyed by a card effect, immediately targeting and Special Summoning a monster from the opponent's GY to your field.

summary.title: Spells & Field Spell
points: Fleuret de Fleur Special Summons a Level 2 or lower monster from your GY with its effects negated and equips to it; if sent to the GY while equipped, it equips itself to a Fleur Synchro Monster.
Ecole de Zone destroys any monster summoned while its controller controls no other monsters, spawning a Mask Token in its place and locking the player out of Extra Deck summons for the turn.
Noble Knight's Shield-Bearer banishes itself from the hand or face-up field to search Horse of the Floral Knights or draw a card by banishing a LIGHT monster.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Baronne de Fleur is Forbidden under the current banlist. Sherry's anime-only cards (Chain Close, Floral Shield, Fleur de Vertiges) were never printed in the real card game.

main: Fleur Synchron
Tuner for Chevalier de Fleur; summons a small monster from the hand when used.
Horse of the Floral Knights
Searches a LIGHT Noble Knight; Fusion Summons with the knights.
Necro Synchron
Counts as Fleur Synchron; summons a Level 1 Plant after a WIND Synchro.
Noble Knight's Spearholder
Makes a monster a Fleur Synchron Tuner; searches an Equip Spell.
Noble Knight's Shield-Bearer
Draws by banishing a LIGHT; searches a WIND Beast like the horse.
Sauge de Fleur
Summons itself by destroying your monster and another card; adds a Level 1 Plant.
Sorciere de Fleur
Steals a monster from their GY for the turn.
Necro Fleur
Level 1 Plant: calls Sorciere de Fleur when an effect destroys it.
Noble Knight Joan
Sherry's Sacred Knight Joan: recovers a Warrior when they destroy it.
Fleuret de Fleur
Revives a small monster; equips a Synchro from the GY.
Ecole de Zone
Sherry's Field Spell: destroys the first lone summon each turn for a Mask Token.
extra: Synchro from Fleur Synchron: negates a Spell/Trap each of your turns.
Fusion of a LIGHT Warrior and a Beast: negates a Trap; revives a small monster.
